analysis: {'Project A': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• Relatively clear – the core value is empowering drivers with knowledge during traffic stops. Reliance on legal sector ads is a potential limitation.', 'Differentiation': '• Limited differentiation – many apps provide legal information.
